additional_info.subject: ID0435850-DC/Si-D/DE-[ MP / R7 170002283]   Electronic fuse FC14 CRM:00642002389
additional_info.body:
Dear Colleagues,
Hope you are doing great.
Please check the following:
Untrip FC14 and see if it comes back to green.
If yes, then it could be that during a boot up the current requested was higher than the fuse can handle and tripped.
If this is the case, probably the HMI is the root cause. You can test by removing the 24V to the HMI here and reboot the charger:
If the FC14 is green, that means that the surge is coming from the HMI and needs to be replaced or change the position where this 24V come from. I already performed this once and changed it to FC12 but this needs to be documented if it's done.
If no, then that means a component is tripping the FC14.
Usually it's the HMI, you can test the same as above by removing the 24V and untrip the FC14 again.
If it goes to green, we have a faulty HMI
If it still is red, we need to understand which component from the 24V line is the root cause.
If it's red, please trial removing one by one from the terminal:
When you find the faulty component follow that line and check if there is any short circuit or replace it.
Since the root cause is usually always the HMI, I recommend taking a spare HMI to site in case you need to replace it.
Please find below attached knowledge article link for your reference.
Knowledge Article: Knowledge Article for ISP: Emobility_SID_HW_Black screen_ FC14 flashing red - Dynamics 365

Fehlersuche vor Ort.
FC14 war beim eintreffen wieder ausgelöst, somit Charger
außer Betrieb.
Sicherung konnte man aber problemlos wieder einschalten und
hat gehalten. Abgehenden Pfad der FC14 kontrollier, keine
Auffälligkeiten festgestellt. Sporadischer Fehler. Durch
mechanische Einwirkung nicht reproduzierbar. Aus Erfahrung
ist hier meist das HMI Backlight das Problem. Mit Kunden
vereinbart das HMI abzuklemmen und 1-2 Wochen zu
beobachten, ob der Fehler erneut auftritt. Falls nein ist es das
HMI und muss ausgetauscht werden. Aktuell Ladestation in
Betrieb, aber HMI nicht nutzbar. Laden über QR Code oder App
möglich.
